display.title: Kill the Ender Guardian
display.subtitle: Boss kill
description: The Ender Guardian lives in the Ruined Citadel, which generates in the End (End Highlands and End Midlands).
An Eye of Void, used like an Eye of Ender, points to the citadel. Be ready for the End first.
The kill itself is tracked once, in the Bosses chapter. This quest completes after that one; just tick it off.
